notes: DRAFT for M7-P6 (lines for the 7 first-session Sensei's Lessons in P5). Same keys as content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json plus 'practice' (the one-line goal shown in the safe practice room, which can't be failed) and 'earliestSession'. Move, Counter and Strike are taught inside the tutorial floor (session 1); Dash, Insights, Bow and Decorating each wait for their own later session, so no session ever gets more than one NEW system after the tutorial. Button names (COUNTER, STRIKE, DASH, Bow) must match the real UI labels; all four checked against ActionButtons.ts and ui/bow.ts ('Bow'). Every line is one sentence; Sensei's success lines reflect, never lecture. No technique names are used because these lessons teach game controls.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: First open of the game (before the tutorial floor)
screens: Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.
You punch all by yourself when you're close.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: See the red circle? An attack is coming.
Tap COUNTER when the circle is almost full.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: Tap it for a big, strong hit.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: After a fight, you can pick one Insight.
